entry_state: The compatibility set is conditional on observation context, precision and model scope. Query answers must distinguish an entire family, individually certain rows and Boolean certainty; a liability of 100 can be certain while its creditor is not. The next derivation has begun showing why aggregation leaves historical movements unidentified, with its interpretation continuing on the next page.
exit_state: Aggregation can leave both movement amounts and economically important contract terms unidentified. Balanced batches conserve a signed functional-currency book, but reporting also needs classified movements, economic state, basis and perimeter. Future simulation must therefore generate economic events and apply accounting treatment rather than evolve statement totals alone.
findings: The nullspace derivation is interpreted on page 87 with remaining feasibility constraints; it does not assert that every algebraic perturbation is admissible.
The receivables bridge and fixed/floating callback distinguish missing movement decomposition from missing contract terms.

Equations 6.2 and 6.3 separate bookkeeping conservation from correct treatment and show why closing cash cannot classify cash flows. Temporary-account closing, currency and perimeter limitations remain explicit.
No confirmed new defect on page 87; the reporting display and surrounding explanations are legible.
